YourMind.body: As more of the work moves to AI and advanced technology, what remains is uniquely yours — your judgment, your intuition, your way of seeing. These aren't gifts. They're cognitive performance. And they depend on a brain that's well fueled.

Credibility.intro: Dr. Jian Kang Liu — then working with legendary biochemist Bruce Ames at UC Berkeley — published three papers in the Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences in a single year. The discovery: a precise combination of acetyl-L-carnitine and R-α-lipoic acid that simultaneously fueled and protected aging mitochondria. The fuel side, the protection side — both in one daily ritual.

one.title: Feeding acetyl-L-carnitine and lipoic acid to old rats significantly improves metabolic function while decreasing oxidative stress.

two.title: Memory loss in old rats is associated with brain mitochondrial decay and RNA/DNA oxidation: Partial reversal by feeding acetyl-L-carnitine and/or R-α-lipoic acid.

three.title: Age-associated mitochondrial oxidative decay: improvement of carnitine acetyltransferase substrate-binding affinity and activity in brain by feeding old rats acetyl-L-carnitine and/or R-α-lipoic acid.

Credibility.closing: That research became the foundation of NuriCell, our flagship formulation. Dr. Liu has guided its evolution ever since — 23 years of refinement, and counting.
